definitions.explanation: An aquatic animal, or fish as food.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}で{魚|さかな}を{見|み}ました。
examples.english: I saw fish in the sea.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{毎週|まいしゅう}{魚|さかな}を{買|か}いに{市場|いちば}へ{行|い}きます。
examples.english: My father goes to the market to buy fish every week.

examples.japanese: この{川|かわ}にはたくさんの{魚|さかな}がいますが、{釣|つ}りをしてはいけません。
examples.english: There are many fish in this river, but you are not allowed to fish here.

notes:
{魚|さかな} refers to both fish as animals and fish as food.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {魚|さかな}を{釣|つ}る: to catch fish
- {魚|さかな}を{焼|や}く: to grill fish
- {魚|さかな}を{捌|さば}く: to fillet fish
- {魚屋|さかなや}: fish shop, fishmonger

COMMON TYPES:
- {鮭|さけ}/{鮭|しゃけ}: salmon
- {鮪|まぐろ}: tuna
- {鯛|たい}: sea bream
- {鯖|さば}: mackerel

CULTURE:
Fish is a staple of Japanese cuisine. Japan is one of the world's largest consumers of seafood per capita.

CONTRAST:
- {魚|さかな}: fish
- {肉|にく}: meat
